content: The Founder stands at the window next to the seedling, his back half to the room. 'Monday I came in to defend the number and the marigold. They're both still here. What's changed is that I've stopped asking people to trust what they can't see. Hands, a name on the terms, a promise in writing, a date we'll keep. My face is still mine, and Community and I will have that argument again with data. Go and do it.' He turns round. 'Thank you. Properly.'

decisions.text: Founder closes the workshop: ranked list, 30-day plan and gate approved; face question deferred to post-test review

content: Head of Product fills the OPEN box. 'Recorded, unresolved, with owners to bring evidence. One: founder's face. Founder vs Community, revisit after hands vs mystique. Two: shouted urgency hooks. Brand vs Growth, decided by the hook test. Three: Archive 002's rank. Growth dissents, re-rank at the gate. Four: the eight-week target. The Founder keeps it as an internal goal, Ops and Plant expect a slip, and the gate decides. Five: spare tees for exchanges. CX vs Ops, decided by checkout size data. Six: weight of the founder survey. Founder vs Research, pending Research's private review. Seven: drop-led vs one-object identity. Brand vs Founder, decided by the framing test. Eight: spare seeds. Plant vs Finance, decided by the germination test. Nothing in this box gets settled by who argues hardest.'
